title: MatrAIx Persona Survey
subtitle: Start with the shortest high-value chunks and stop whenever the next chunk is not worth the time.
privacy: Responses are saved only in this local MatrAIx folder. Nothing is sent to an external service by the survey.
scoring_note: IPIP results use absolute response bands without population norms. Partial results are provisional. The risk module is DOSPERT-inspired and must not be reported as an official DOSPERT score.

modules.title: Correct the highest-impact gaps
modules.description: Confirm or replace weak facts first. Sensitive questions can be marked private or skipped.

modules.title: Capture your conversational fingerprint

modules.title: Rank the values behind your decisions
modules.description: A forced ranking resolves priorities that rating scales often leave tied.

questions.prompt: Rank the five values that most guide your real decisions.
If forced to choose for several years, which matters more?

What are your non-negotiable principles? Give concrete examples if useful.

modules.title: Domain risk profile - anchors
modules.description: Two original scenarios per domain. This follows the five-domain DOSPERT structure but is not the validated DOSPERT instrument.

questions.prompt: Keep excess change when a cashier makes a small mistake in your favor.
Put a meaningful share of your savings into one volatile investment.

Take an unfamiliar hiking route with changing weather and limited phone signal.
